title: Keyboard Shortcut Conflict: Line Break Behavior Unclear in Chat Interface
body:
**Bug Description**
< Shift > + < Enter > sends instead of makes a line break. There is no hint how to make a line break. Instead "Claude Code" does not check that the user wanted to add information and tries to change code.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 0.2.9
- Feedback ID: d5480ac5-79ad-443f-b16d-7f87eb2decad
author: deniercounter
